purpose: silver_nyc_flights cleans the bronze capture of the nycflights13 flights table, covering every January-June 2013 departure from JFK, LGA, and EWR, for downstream analytics on flight punctuality, routing, and carrier performance.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time as HHMM-encoded integers (not clock times; values like 2400 occur) and parse them explicitly if a true time is needed. Rows with null dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, or air_time represent flights that never departed or arrived and must be filtered or handled explicitly before computing delay statistics; tailnum may also be null. time_hour is a parsed UTC TIMESTAMP suitable for time-series joins.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped and carry no business meaning. dep_time and dep_delay are null for 2.9% of rows, arr_time for 3.1%, and arr_delay and air_time for 3.3%, reflecting flights that never departed or arrived; tailnum is null for 0.9% of rows; none of these nulls were imputed. No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across 166158 rows), so no dedupe logic was applied, and the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, sched_dep_time) has not been measured against the full warehouse.
